text.# Pequenas produtoras e anúncios curtos:
# Small production companies and short AI ads

## Summary
Studios of just a few people already deliver 15- to 30-second ads that combine a generated script, images and sound, with traditional editing at the end [1][3].

## Examples
- A three-person studio made a short in ten days [3].
- Five studios released shorts with generative video in the same month [1].

## Costs
The biggest cost is no longer the shoot but the review: each shot is usually generated several times [3].

## Risks
Image rights, character consistency and client approval at every stage [2].
